messages.body:

file
&general
startframe=240000,endframe=250000, interval=5,
verbose=2, keep_files=0,
strip_mask=.788-14970, entropy=1,
/
&gb
igb=2,saltcon=0.00,surfoff=0.00,surften=0.005,
/
&pb
cavity_surften=0.005, cavity_offset=0.00, inp=1, radiopt=0,

someone could help me with this.
Thanking you in advance
Ramanathan R
